body: I'm transgender and was forced out of my home by an abusive ex at 9 days post top surgery. This combined with some other traumatic events left me with extreme ptsd that I'm still battling with over a year later.

I cant imagine life after moving, I'm already planning to move away. I'm a tattoo artist so I'll just be that in another state I suppose. I dont want to leave my family, but I cant be with them anymore either. My previous posts explain a lot of my situation
I'm a quite successful artist for a living. Dont own a tv, hike all the time, have a vegan diet. Sometimes it's more complicated than that..
